cases.adjudication: Full report documents concrete SD/SE and data-entry issues and an important changed take-option result; correction bundle also changes censoring/definition. Material impact of hard mistakes alone not isolated.
cases.mechanism: For List aggregate data, SDs used instead of SEs, underweighting study. Some negative-mean treatments omitted; Bardsley participant counts mistaken across treatments; negative giving truncated to zero in aggregate and excluded from individual data. These issues have different epistemic status: SD/SE and transcription are computational/data errors; censoring and comparable-giving definitions require substantive assessment.
cases.consequence: 2012 working-paper Table 6 take-option meta-regression coefficient -0.331 (p<.001), OLS -0.428 (p<.001), treatment FE -0.272 (p<.001), Tobit -0.362 (p<.001); original take-option estimates nonsignificant. Final 2014 comment reports a different meta coefficient (-0.603) after broader recoding; do not interchange versions. Most other findings described as robust.
cases.correction_only: The displayed consequence follows bundled recoding/reinstatement of negative giving and hard data errors. A hard-errors-only correction is not reported in the inspected full 2012 paper. Separate normalized-giving analyses alter the outcome reference point further.
